headline: Apple Reports Stronger-Than-Expected Revenue for Third Fiscal Quarter
summary: Apple Inc posted stronger-than-expected revenue of $30.71 billion in its fiscal third quarter, marking an upbeat start for new CEO John Ternus and bucking a downward trend among tech giants.
why: Apple is one of the world's largest technology companies, and its financial results serve as a key bellwether for consumer demand and the broader technology sector.

impacts.name: Apple Inc
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected revenue and earnings results typically drive the company's stock price higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company posted revenue of $30.71 billion that exceeded analysts' expectations, providing positive momentum for the new CEO.
